pl-l4d42c6-d1e115.summary: Asks whether a wife should sponsor a child at baptism together with her husband.

pl-l4d42c6-d1e118.summary: Cites Urban: no authority forbids a wife and husband to sponsor a child together at baptism, but to keep the purity of spiritual paternity free from all stain and infamy, we decree that both should not aspire to it together; one who married two co-mothers as if sisters committed a crime deserving great penance.
claims: Spouses should not jointly sponsor a child.

pl-l4d42c6.summary: Asks whether husband and wife should together sponsor a child at baptism. Urban: no authority forbids it, but to keep spiritual paternity free of stain, both should not presume to do so together; one who married two co-mothers like sisters committed a grave sin requiring great penance.
claims: Spouses should not sponsor the same child together.
Marrying two co-mothers in succession requires grave penance.
